statement: The recorded flight-out date of 16 March is incorrect and unsafe for this case: the conference runs 12–15 March and Dana's talk is on the morning of 13 March, so she must arrive by 12 March. I'll book the flight out for 12 March.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The recorded flight-out date of 16 March is incorrect" because the conference ends 15 March and gives the corrected date of 12 March.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
